Name: Big Silo
Author: lperkins2
Description:
The default silo stores less than a single full stack of hay, and no where near as much as devoting the same space to chests gives you.  You need one silo to grow your own hay, but why would you ever build more?  This mod fixes this problem, allowing somewhere around 200k hay per silo, the same amount as you'd get devoting the space to the much cheaper 8 chests.

Uses Harmony to replace StardewValley.Utility.numSilos and return a higher number.  Note that you do still need at least one silo, since this just multiplies the number of silos counted.

Manifest.Name: Big Silo
Manifest.Description: Increases the silo capacity to what you'd get storing hay in chests taking up the same space.
